posts.name: Matchstickman
posts.cooked:
So I finally got a copy of Shattered Timeliens today (Woot!) and spent the afternoon looking over the cards and reading all the flavour text.

 

I did a search on the forum for "Treacherous Ape " but found nothing, have we no wild speculation thread on it?

What is the deal with it and the crystal it holds and why is it on "The Dreamer Dreams" character card?

The closest I can get to any thought of coherent thought on it is as the Time-Crazed prisoner is ranting about "the child is the center" could the Ape be the Servant of "it", making sure the child starts whatever it needs to do?

 

Or am I wildly off base and it's all just Vanessa's stuffed toy?

I too have always wondered what made the Ape so treacherous.  I mean, besides the fact that it's at a circus and therefore is obviously up to no good.

The fact that it's an ape in a comicbook setting is usually enough.

This thread brings a thought to mind: We are dreadfully low on ape-based villians. Villanous apes are a staple of comics just as much as the mad scientist or warlord from space(Especially in the Golden Age of comics!)

To any Devs that would care to listen! A projection with just two hp can't hope to fill the void of a real manevolent monkey monarch. Is there any chance that we could get an corupt Kong or Maniacle Mo-Mo in the future?
